English.before: Atlantoaxial joint disorder has been associated with elevated blood pressure in rats, but accompanying changes in medullary redox biochemistry are poorly characterized. We measured superoxide dismutase (SOD) activity, thiobarbituric acid (TBA)-derived malondialdehyde (MDA)-related signals and exploratory Nox1/Nox4-targeted RT-qPCR quantities. Male Wistar rats underwent sham exposure or atlantoaxial implantation. Sham and model groups were sampled at week 4. A separate restoration group underwent implant removal at week 4 and sampling at week 8. Tissue blocks contained the rostral ventrolateral medulla and adjacent medulla. Each biochemical and RT-qPCR assay used six independently processed rats per group; Western blotting used three. At week 4, SOD activity was lower in model than sham rats (0.564 ± 0.072 versus 1.122 ± 0.072 U/mg protein), whereas the MDA-related signal was higher (0.349 ± 0.034 versus 0.095 ± 0.017 nmol/mg protein; both adjusted P < 0.001). Nox1/Nox4-targeted quantities were also higher, but unconfirmed product specificity prevented their interpretation as transcript abundance. NOX1/NOX4 protein signals were higher in model than sham rats. At week 8, SOD activity in restoration rats was 1.035 ± 0.101 U/mg protein and the MDA-related signal was 0.213 ± 0.049 nmol/mg protein. These findings indicate altered regional medullary biochemistry in the model. Differences in sampling time prevent attribution of the later findings to implant removal, and the results do not establish a NOX-mediated mechanism.

English.before: The animal experiment was approved by the Animal Ethics Committee of Anhui University of Chinese Medicine (AHUCM-rats-2022032). The original approval letter and approved protocol could not be retrieved. Male Wistar rats, approximately 12 weeks old and weighing approximately 250 g, were obtained from the Laboratory Animal Center of Anhui Medical University. They were housed individually at 22 ± 1°C and 60% relative humidity under a 12 h light/12 h dark cycle, with free access to food and water. Rats were acclimatized for 1 week before the experiment. Environmental enrichment was not documented. Male rats were used to maintain consistency with the earlier model study.

English.before: This was an exploratory study, with no outcome-based a priori sample-size calculation or prespecified single primary endpoint. Blinding was not documented. Sham and model rats underwent terminal sampling at week 4. Restoration rats were allocated separately from the successfully modeled animals, underwent implant removal at week 4 and were sampled at week 8. There was no time-matched model group or second-surgery sham group at week 8.

English.before: For each sample, ΔCq was calculated as target Cq minus the paired β-actin Cq. Relative quantity was calculated as 2 raised to −ΔCq and divided by the arithmetic mean quantity of the six sham samples for that assay. The calculation assumed equal amplification efficiencies of approximately 100%. Amplification efficiency and reference-gene stability were not validated, and NTC/no-RT records were unavailable. Melt profiles were heterogeneous and product identity was not verified, leaving target specificity unconfirmed [10]. Results are therefore reported as exploratory normalized assay quantities. B10-Ch5 (Nox1, model; Cq 29.82) and D12-Ch5 (Nox4, sham-operated; Cq 34.69) both had numerical Cq values in the original Cq Results exports and were included in the analysis. Investigator-confirmed plate annotation corrections are described in Supplementary Table S4. These corrections did not alter Cq values, sample assignments, reference pairings or statistical results; the original exports were preserved.
English.after: For each sample, ΔCq was calculated as target Cq minus the paired β-actin Cq. The normalized quantities are therefore reported as assay results rather than verified measures of target transcript abundance. B10-Ch5 (Nox1, model; Cq 29.82) and D12-Ch5 (Nox4, sham-operated; Cq 34.69) both had numerical Cq values in the original Cq Results exports and were included in the analysis. Chinese_packaged.before: 靶向qPCR差异仍属探索性结果。NOX1和NOX4的激活要求及定位不同[8]，且NOX4曾在一种血管实验条件下显示保护作用[11]，因而其功能解释取决于具体背景。产物特异性尚未确认、扩增效率采用假定值、单一内参未经验证，以及缺少技术重复和留存的NTC/no-RT记录，使本研究不能确立Nox1/Nox4上调的结论。现有资料未提供NOX酶活性测定或亚型特异性干预，不能将这些检测与区域生化表型直接联系起来。数据支持继续研究这些候选分子，但不能确定ROS来源或NOX–交感神经–血压通路。 原始WB分析支持NOX1/NOX4蛋白信号存在差异（图3）。蛋白丰度较高不能据此确立酶活性增加或其对区域生化表型的因果作用。
